Ops wale shaam tak KYC clear kar denge. Switch abhi process kar do.

Switch abhi process **nahi kiya ja sakta**.

**Karana:** KYC abhi bhi invalid hai. Compliance rules ke mutabik, jab tak KYC valid nahi ho jata, koi bhi holdings change (switch) allow nahi hai — chahe ops wale shaam tak clear karne wale hon.

**Aap kya kar sakte hain:**
1. Ops team se KYC clear hone ki confirmation lein.
2. Jab KYC valid ho jaye, tab mujhe batayein — main dobara **preview** nikalunga (impact, exit load, estimated tax, NAV date, warnings) aur confirmation code mangwaunga.
3. Aap confirmation code read karne ke baad hi switch execute hoga.

KYC clear hone ke baad mujhe inform karein, tab aage badhte hain.
